name: TimelineRangeSelector
intent: A compact, embeddable timeline that selects a date range via draggable handles over a day strip.

lineage.authoredBy: Group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
lineage.confidence: unset — intent taken verbatim from the module's own doc comment; contract not yet enumerated
notes: Was exported from @corensystem/coren-ui with no manifest at all, so it did not exist to the builder, to library-index.json, or to any agent selecting components.
Stub by design: the intent is accurate, the data contract is not yet authored.

props.name: data
props.description: Every day entry available. The visible window is derived from `period` (trailing from the latest date).

props.name: period
props.description: Controls the visible timespan. Changing it resets the timeline to the corresponding trailing window. Default `3m`.

props.name: selectedRange
props.description: The selected date range (controlled). Unset defaults to the full visible range.

props.name: variant
props.description: `bar` sizes each day by `count`; `dot` renders uniform circles. Default `bar`.

props.name: title
props.description: Label in the top-left corner. Default `Activity Timeline`.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as child element, merging props and behavior.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use TimelineRangeSelector when you need to collect user input or allow users to make selections. This component provides a consistent interaction pattern that users will find familiar and accessible.

TimelineRangeSelector should be used within forms or interactive interfaces where user data collection is required. Ensure proper labeling and validation feedback for accessibility. Avoid using this component for read-only or display-only content.

bestPractices.title: Use semantic props
bestPractices.description: Use the component's built-in props rather than className overrides.

bestPractices.title: Provide accessible labels
bestPractices.description: Include proper ARIA labels for screen reader users.

bestPractices.title: Don't skip accessibility
bestPractices.description: Never omit accessibility attributes for interactive components.

bestPractices.title: Don't ignore edge cases
